authorInfo.bio: John Bunyan was an English writer and nonconformist preacher. He is best remembered as the author of the Christian allegory The Pilgrim's Progress, which also became an influential literary model. In addition to The Pilgrim's Progress, Bunyan wrote nearly sixty titles, many of them expanded sermons.

description: "Works of John Bunyan — Complete" by John Bunyan is a collection of religious treatises compiled in the late 17th century. This comprehensive anthology includes Bunyan's most significant works, along with an introduction, annotations, and a biographical sketch, providing insights into his life and the era in which he lived.
